intro_en: Uncivilization is a conceptual and organizational entity.
intro_tr: Uncivilization, kavramsal ve organizasyonel bir oluşumdur.

notes.text: We're organizing EVENTS in **İZMİR** and **İSTANBUL**. We are interested in making events in other places as well.
notes.more: if you have a space to offer for our events we would like to hear about it.

notes.text: Uncivilization LABEL is on fair music platforms. [mirlo](https://mirlo.space/uncivilization/), [fairplayer](https://fairplayer.band/player/artist/uncivilization@mirlo.space), [bandwagon](https://bandwagon.fm/@uncivilization), [acidnation](https://www.acidnation.com/label/uncivilization), [audius](https://audius.co/uncivilization), [artcore](https://www.artcore.com/uncivilization), [distrosub](https://www.distrosub.com/label/uncivilization), [itch.io](https://unciv.itch.io/), [bandcamp](https://uncivilization.bandcamp.com/album/no-boundaries-jungle-remixes) and [soundcloud](https://soundcloud.com/uncvl/sets/no-boundaries-jungle-remixes).
notes.more: if you are a music producer and you are into bass, breakcore, hardcore or punk, consider sending us your tunes.

call.head: UNCIVILIZATION calls music producers, artists and story tellers to be a part of EXTINCTION compilation album series.
call.body: We're collecting material for the first chapter of Extinction Series: EXTINCTION X. The compilation is planned to be a set of audio, artwork, illustration, visuals and text.
